designer.name: Shiwani Kumari
designer.intro: Showrooms, exhibitions, homes and public libraries across Nepal and beyond.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Balaju
projects.blurb: A dealer showroom planned end to end, from the outline survey and furniture circulation to joinery details for the product racks, colour lab and reception.
projects.hook: It started with a blank 27-foot box and a tin of paint.

projects.title: The Bunker
projects.client: Red Bull × Suraj Singh Thakuri, Inside The Bunker
projects.blurb: The set for Inside The Bunker, Suraj Singh Thakuri's podcast with Red Bull: a survivors' bunker in rusted steel, a spiral stair, one lamp over the table, maps and photographs pinned to raw concrete. Built, lit and on air since February 2026.
projects.hook: A room for the survivors of a war.

projects.title: Villa Facades, Bahrain
projects.blurb: Massing and colour studies for a contemporary villa, with interior moods for the main living room.
projects.hook: Three colours, one wall, and a desert sun that forgives nothing.

projects.title: Catch Masala Masterchef Activation
projects.blurb: A live-cooking stage, spice cart, recipe wall and modular racks for a brand activation.
projects.hook: Can a spice have a stage? We gave it one.

projects.title: IFB Mela Stall
projects.blurb: A New Year experience zone built around a circular portal and a washing-zone vignette.
projects.hook: Walk through a washing machine. Literally.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Janakpur
projects.blurb: A compact dealer showroom with tinting machine, product walls and a feature-finish backdrop.
projects.hook: The smallest showroom on the trip. Every inch had a job.

projects.title: Asian Paints Dealer Meet
projects.blurb: A walk-through brand world: Bling moment rooms, texture galleries, demonstration zones and the Excelerate brand shop.
projects.hook: A thousand dealers, one hall, and a mirror that said 'gold mode on'.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Budanilkantha
projects.blurb: Dealer showroom concept.
projects.hook: Up the hill where the sleeping Vishnu lies.

projects.title: American Space
projects.blurb: Library and community space concept.
projects.hook: A library that had to feel like a living room.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Pepsicola
projects.blurb: Dealer showroom concept.
projects.hook: Paint is sold by colour. So the walls had to sell first.

projects.title: Innovation Hub, American Space Teku
projects.blurb: Reception, book stacks, robotics corner, programming hall and a semicircular reading nook for Kathmandu's Innovation Hub.
projects.hook: Robots, books and a curved blue sofa. The Innovation Hub.

projects.title: American Space, Bhairahawa
projects.blurb: Maker's room, reading hall, floating shelves and a screen wall for a regional American Space.
projects.hook: At the border town, a room for big ideas.

projects.title: American Corner, Surkhet
projects.blurb: Cabins, registration, music room, computer lab and a red-white-blue reading area.
projects.hook: 47 slides, one question: where does a kid in Surkhet go to dream?

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Dang
projects.blurb: Counselling zone, product display, machine area and panel display zones.
projects.hook: In the western plains, a counter where colour is chosen.

projects.title: American Corner, Biratnagar
projects.blurb: Library concept for eastern Nepal.
projects.hook: Eastern Nepal's corner for American books and Nepali voices.

projects.title: Asian Paints Exhibition Stall
projects.blurb: A long, open-fronted stall built to be read from across the hall: a sculpted fascia with a circular cut-out, textured feature walls that carry the finishes themselves, a run of product panels along the back and a small seating pocket, so a visitor can take it in from the aisle and walk it in a minute.
projects.hook: The stall that had to stop a crowd mid-walk.

projects.title: Mithila Art Gallery & Studio
projects.blurb: A gallery and teaching studio built around Mithila painting, the folk art of the Terai that women have painted on the walls of their homes for generations. The figures, fish and lotus borders are hand painted onto the walls themselves, so the tradition is in the room, not only in the frames. Floor seating, a workshop hall and timber niches for finished work.
projects.hook: Where the walls teach before the teacher does.

projects.title: Creators Mela
projects.blurb: Entrance portal, main and side stages, and sponsor stalls for a creators' festival.
projects.hook: A neon tunnel for people who make things.

projects.title: 2BHK Residence, India
projects.blurb: A full apartment: living, kitchen, balcony swing, two bedrooms, baths and a lotus and Om puja wall.
projects.hook: Two bedrooms, one balcony swing, and a lotus that glows at night.

projects.title: Asian Paints CN 2026, Colour Trends
projects.blurb: Four immersive trend worlds, Pastoral, IRL, Solar Punk and Daydream, plus the Coty colour booth.
projects.hook: Four futures of colour. One of them grows a mountain indoors.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Chitwan II
projects.blurb: A large-format showroom with full product walls, WPCC zone and a lounge.
projects.hook: Rhino country gets a wall of 600 paint tins.

projects.title: American Space, Pokhara
projects.blurb: Library concept for Pokhara.
projects.hook: Beside the lake, a library with a view of the Annapurnas.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Chitwan I
projects.blurb: Panel walls for interior, exterior and wood finishes around a consultation counter.
projects.hook: Interior. Exterior. Wood. Three walls, three decisions.

projects.title: Coca-Cola Football Kiosk
projects.blurb: A spin-the-wheel promotional kiosk.
projects.hook: Spin the wheel. Football fever in a kiosk.

projects.title: New B.R. Enterprises, Manbhawan
projects.blurb: Designed and delivered: the render became a working showroom. Watch the walkthrough of the finished space.
projects.hook: The render came true. Then we filmed it.

projects.title: Master Bedroom
projects.blurb: Herringbone oak, fluted headboard and full-height wardrobe joinery.
projects.hook: Herringbone, oak and a quiet room to land in.

projects.title: Private Residence
projects.blurb: Hall, kitchen, puja unit and a carved timber jali screen, plus a terracotta-and-teal bar lounge.
projects.hook: A home where the puja room and the bar are neighbours.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Birtamod
projects.blurb: Two showroom options for an eastern Nepal dealer.
projects.hook: Two options for the far east. The dealer picked both.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Chunilaal
projects.blurb: A corner showroom with wraparound fascia, feature wall and finishes library.
projects.hook: A corner shop that had to shout from both streets.

projects.title: Asian Paints Exhibition 2026
projects.blurb: An open stall that reads as a home rather than a trade counter. Three arched alcoves carry Royale, Bling and Ultima. A stone arch doorway opens into a lounge, and a grey portal with an oval mirror anchors the centre. Visitors walk through rooms, not past a counter.
projects.hook: A stall disguised as a home, with arches, alcoves and a stone doorway.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Putalisadak
projects.blurb: A narrow city showroom organised around a central consultation bar.
projects.hook: Kathmandu's busiest street. A narrow room. A bar in the middle.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Dharan
projects.blurb: Shutter-fronted showroom with finishes library, discussion table and product walls.
projects.hook: Behind the shutters, a finishes library.

projects.title: Asian Paints Showroom, Pokhara
projects.blurb: Showroom with sculpted reception, finishes library and an illuminated product wall.
projects.hook: Lake city, lit product wall.

story.title: Two years. 33 rooms.
story.hook: Every corner of Nepal has a story. These are the rooms I left in them.
lines: Showrooms, libraries, stages and homes, from the Terai plains to the hills of Kathmandu.
Some stayed on paper. Some got built.
Every corner comes with a story.
